pally.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Pally.gg right now.

pally.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a Pally.gg campaign tip inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to Pally.gg and it works without a connection.

parameters.kind: Optional. Which event. Only "campaignTip" exists, and it is the default.

pally.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test tip was sent, false when the kind is unknown.
